title: Best ChatGPT Apps and Connectors for Shipping a Website (October 2026)

body_markdown:
ChatGPT can publish a website only through an app that hosts it. On its own, it writes code and stops. If the app you connect ends on a link a stranger can open, it ships websites. If it ends on a design, a draft, or a file, it does not.


## The short version


ChatGPT apps are outside tools you call inside a chat by typing "@" and the app's name.


Most website apps design, write, or inspect. Only a few put a site on a live URL.


The ones that do are builders with their own hosting: Wix, Lovable, Replit, Hostinger Horizons, and Floot.


On Floot, the site is live on its own URL from the first build, with the backend and database included.


On other builders, publishing often finishes in a second editor, and the domain or hosting is billed separately.


The rest of this guide covers what ChatGPT apps are, which ones get a site live, the quick test, and what each builder makes you do.


## ChatGPT apps, in one picture


Think of ChatGPT as an architect. It can draw any house you describe in seconds. A drawing is still not a house.


Apps are the contractors it can call from the drafting table. Canva picks the paint. Stripe runs the register. A few build the house and hand you the keys. Those are the builders that host.


The split exists because ChatGPT runs conversations, not servers, and a site has to keep running after the chat ends.


## Which ChatGPT apps actually get a website live


Five apps take you from a description to a live URL: Floot, Wix, Lovable, Replit, and Hostinger Horizons. The rest help with one part of the job. (A "live URL" means the app itself publishes a site anyone can open.)


OpenAI launched apps in October 2025, built on MCP, the open standard Claude and Cursor also use. Trackers counted about 2,300 apps in August 2026.


Floot. What it does in ChatGPT: Builds and hosts pages, backend, database, logins. Live URL: Yes, on the first build.


Wix. What it does in ChatGPT: Builds a Wix Harmony site from a description. Live URL: Yes.


Lovable. What it does in ChatGPT: Creates a full-stack app with a live preview. Live URL: Yes, after you publish in Lovable.


Replit. What it does in ChatGPT: Builds and deploys web apps with Replit Agent. Live URL: Yes.


Hostinger. What it does in ChatGPT: Turns a prompt into a Hostinger Horizons site. Live URL: Yes.


Webflow. What it does in ChatGPT: Generates and publishes sections of a site. Live URL: Only for an existing site.


Canva. What it does in ChatGPT: Makes designs and brand assets. Live URL: No.


Vercel. What it does in ChatGPT: Inspects projects, deployments, and build logs. Live URL: No.


GitHub. What it does in ChatGPT: Reads repos and reasons over code. Live URL: Only via GitHub Pages setup.


Stripe. What it does in ChatGPT: Looks up revenue, customers, and refunds. Live URL: No.


## Floot


Floot builds and hosts the whole site from the chat, backend and database included. It fits a founder who wants forms, logins, or saved data without another tool.


## Wix


Wix builds a brochure site from a description, and you refine it in the Wix editor. Your own domain needs a paid Wix plan.


## Lovable


Lovable creates a full-stack project with a live preview. You publish from Lovable itself.


## Replit


Replit Agent builds and deploys web apps. Replit bills deployments on top of your ChatGPT plan.


## Hostinger Horizons


Hostinger turns a prompt into a hosted site on a Hostinger plan, with the domain in the same place.


## Canva and Stripe


Canva makes the logo, colors, and hero images. Stripe checks revenue and refunds, but your builder still wires the checkout into the site.


Notice the pattern. Every "Yes" in the table belongs to a company that also runs servers.


## Does this app ship your site?


Here is the quick test. Ask whether the app ends on a link a stranger can open.


If it ends on an image, a code snippet, or a dashboard, it is a helper. Canva, Vercel, GitHub, and Stripe belong here.


If it ends on a URL you could text to a customer, it is a builder, and that is the one app you need. For a small business, add one design app, and Stripe if you take payments.


## What each tool makes you do


Every builder on the list starts a site in ChatGPT. Where it ends up is where they differ.


Wix and Hostinger move you into their own editors. Lovable finishes publishing in Lovable. Replit bills deployments separately. Webflow only publishes into a site you already have.


The pattern is the same everywhere it goes wrong: the chat produces something that looks finished, then publishing or the bill sends you to a second tool.


Floot is the ChatGPT app that ends on a link. Most apps in the directory make one piece of a website: a design, an image, a draft. You describe the site in ChatGPT, and your assistant builds it onto Floot: the pages, the small server programs called endpoints behind the contact form and the booking button ("send me the inquiry," "hold this time slot"), and a Postgres database, live on its own URL from the first build. Pro includes one free custom domain.


Because Floot also includes the database, logins with Google, Microsoft, and email, file storage, email sending, scheduled jobs, and live updates, the site can grow into an app without moving. You never sign up for anything else, and the thinking stays on your ChatGPT plan, so there is no second AI bill.


## FAQ


## Can ChatGPT publish a website?


Not on its own. It needs a builder app that hosts, such as Floot, Wix, Lovable, Replit, or Hostinger.


## What is the best ChatGPT app for building a website?


For a brochure site you will edit by hand, Wix. For a site with forms, logins, or saved data that stays in the chat, Floot.


## Are ChatGPT apps free?


Many connect on ChatGPT Free, but the app's company may charge for publishing.


## Is there a ChatGPT app for buying a domain?


We did not find a domain registrar or small-site analytics app in the directory as of Sept 25, 2026. Buy the domain from a registrar and point it at your site.


## What is the difference between ChatGPT apps and connectors?


Connectors was the earlier name for apps that bring your data in. They now sit under apps.


## Does Floot work in ChatGPT?


Yes. You describe the site in a ChatGPT chat, and Floot builds and hosts it.
